facts.fact: Vercel says more than 4 million people have used v0 since it became generally available in 2024 to turn ideas into apps.
facts.quote: Since v0 became generally available in 2024, more than 4 million people have used it to turn their ideas into apps in minutes.

facts.fact: Vercel says the new v0 API is now generally available, giving programmatic, headless access to v0's app-building agent.
facts.quote: The new API is now generally available.

facts.fact: Per Vercel, the v0 API sends a prompt, starts a dev server in a Vercel Sandbox, and returns a preview URL that can be embedded in a user's own UI.
facts.quote: Send a prompt and v0 generates an app, starts a dev server in a Vercel Sandbox, and gives you a preview URL you can embed in your own UI.

facts.fact: Vercel says Vercel Connect, its secure connectivity layer for AI agents and apps, is now generally available.
facts.quote: Vercel Connect, the secure connectivity layer for AI agents and apps, is now generally available.
